title: Continuing after a restart
match: mission control restarted while your previous turn

steps.text: Picking this back up. The checkout still has the edits from before the restart, and the one thing I was actually blocked on never got answered - so I am asking again rather than guessing at it.

questions.question: What should a caller get when it sends a cursor this build cannot decode?

options.label: 400 with an error
options.description: refuse it loudly, so a client bug surfaces at the call site instead of looking like an empty result

options.label: Restart from the first page
options.description: treat an undecodable cursor as absent - forgiving, but a paging bug then reads as an infinite list

questions.question: Should the page size stay caller-controlled?

options.label: Caller-controlled, capped at 100
options.description: keep the existing limit parameter and clamp it

options.label: Fixed at 50
options.description: drop the parameter, so every page is the same size and cursors stay comparable

steps.text: Thanks - that unblocks the last two call sites. Applying it and re-running the suite before I hand this back.
Green. Every call site is on the cursor now, and an undecodable one is refused rather than silently restarting the list.
